items.title: GPT-5.6 is here but...
items.summary: Etched 正在构建前沿推理集群，通过芯片、机架、软件及制造的极端垂直整合，实现了在 TSMC 4nm 工艺上首次流片即成功（A0）。该公司已筹集 8 亿美元，拥有超过 10 亿美元的积压订单，并正与 TSMC 进行生产合作，旨在解决 AI 推理中的延迟、成本及功耗瓶颈。
items.why_now: GPT-5.6发布但受美国政府封锁，仅向选定合作伙伴开放。
items.summary_en: Etched, a new AI inference hardware company, has secured $800 million in funding and holds over $1 billion in backlog orders, achieving first-chip success on TSMC’s 4nm process in under three years. While OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 launch faces US government restrictions limiting access to select partners, broader industry developments include Cursor for iOS enabling always-on cloud agents and Replit launching desktop applications.

items.title: Have your agent record video demos of its work with shot-scraper video
items.summary: shot-scraper 1.10 版本新增 `video` 命令，利用 Playwright 和 storyboard.yml 文件自动录制 Web 应用操作视频，旨在让编码代理（如 GPT-5.5 xhigh）生成工作演示。该功能通过定义包含服务器启动、URL 访问及具体交互步骤（如点击、填充文本、等待元素）的 YAML 脚本，实现对 Datasette 等应用的自动化视频录制。
items.why_now: shot-scraper 1.10今日发布视频录制功能，助力AI Agent自动生成工作演示。
items.summary_en: Shot-scraper 1.10 introduces a video command that uses Playwright to record web application routines defined in a storyboard.yml file. This tool enables coding agents, such as those running GPT-5.5 xhigh in Codex Desktop, to automatically generate video demonstrations of their work, exemplified by creating data tables in Datasette.

items.title: [AINews] Sonnet 5 today, and Fable 5 tomorrow
items.summary: Anthropic发布Claude Sonnet 5，定位为最具代理能力的Sonnet模型，具备规划、浏览器及终端工具使用能力，提供100万Token上下文窗口，标准价格为输入3美元/百万Token、输出15美元/百万Token，并推出至9月1日的促销价（输入2美元、输出10美元）。尽管市场此前预期Fable 5将同步发布，但该版本并未上线，此次更新主要聚焦于平台支持扩展（如Linux桌面版）及Managed Agents功能增强。
items.why_now: Anthropic今日发布Sonnet 5 API并推出限时降价促销。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Sonnet 5 as its new default mid-tier frontier model, featuring a 1M-token context window and enhanced agentic capabilities for coding and tool use. The model maintains a standard price of $3M input/$15M output tokens, with a promotional rate of $2M/$10M available through late August, while simultaneously expanding platform support to include Linux desktop versions and updated Managed Agents features. Although Sonnet 5 is positioned as Anthropic’s most agentic model yet, its release coincided with the delayed return of the higher-end Fable/Mythos 5, which remains subject to government approval.

items.title: What's new in Claude Sonnet 5
items.summary: Anthropic发布Claude Sonnet 5，其性能接近Opus 4.8，支持100万token上下文窗口及默认自适应思考功能。由于采用新分词器，英文和代码输入的Token数量增加约30%，导致实际成本上升，而简体中文处理成本基本持平。API层面不再支持temperature等采样参数，定价策略虽维持原价但受分词变化影响实质涨价。
items.why_now: Claude Sonnet 5今早发布，新分词器变相涨价30%。
items.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5, a model with performance nearing Opus 4.8 but priced lower, featuring a 1 million token context window and adaptive thinking enabled by default. Despite identical base pricing to Sonnet 4.6, the introduction of a new tokenizer results in approximately 30% more tokens per input, effectively increasing costs by 1.3x to 1.4x for languages like English and Spanish. Key API changes include the removal of sampling parameters like temperature and top_p, while retaining the same toolset as Sonnet 4.6.

items.title: Experience "Starting an App" with AI -0 experience, 2,900 users and community funded
items.summary: 作者利用Claude AI（$20/月）独立完成了一款农场管理应用的开发，凭借零代码经验在一个月内实现盈利。该应用通过Facebook等社交媒体进行免费有机推广，累计获得2,900名用户及约15次五星好评。其商业模式完全由用户资助，月收入约260美元（含订阅和一次性捐赠），扣除每月约71美元的运营成本后，目前净利润约为220美元。
items.why_now: 非程序员零代码一月内用Claude建站获利
items.summary_en: A non-coder built a homestead analytics app entirely using Claude’s $20/month plan, achieving 2,900 users in under a month through organic Facebook marketing. The project operates on a user-funded donation model rather than ads or paywalls, generating approximately $440 in total donations against $71 in monthly operational costs. This transparent, community-driven approach resulted in a current net profit of about $220 with minimal ongoing development time.

items.title: Sonnet 5 review: I ran 64 generations to find out if it's worth it
items.summary: 作者构建了名为 How I AI Bench 的可重复评估框架，对 Anthropic Sonnet 5 与 Sonnet 4.6、Opus 4.8、GPT-5.5 及 Gemini 3 Pro 进行了盲测。测试涵盖 PRD 质量、原型生成、智能体任务完成度等维度，并结合人类评分（70%）与 LLM 裁判评分（30%）得出综合排名结果。研究旨在通过系统化基准测试替代主观直觉判断，为不同场景下的前沿模型选择提供数据支持。
items.why_now: Anthropic刚发布Sonnet 5，独立开发者需立即评估其性能优势以抢占技术窗口。
items.summary_en: The author evaluated Anthropic’s Sonnet 5 against Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.8, GPT-5.5, and Gemini 3 Pro using a custom repeatable harness called the How I AI Bench. This evaluation combined 70% human vibe scoring with 30% LLM-as-a-judge metrics to assess performance on PRD quality, prototype generation, and agentic tasks. The review provides specific model recommendations for different use cases based on these comparative results.

items.title: Meta's brain-reading AI leaves letters behind
items.summary: Meta发布了非侵入式脑机接口系统Brain2Qerty v2，通过两个AI模型分别处理原始信号和语义，使平均单词识别准确率从8%跃升至61%，接近手术植入方案。该成果基于9名志愿者在扫描仪中停留10小时产生的近22,000句数据训练得出，且Meta已开源v1和v2的代码及数据集以推动技术普及。
items.why_now: Meta开源Brain2Qwerty v2，非侵入式脑机接口准确率飙升。
items.summary_en: Meta released Brain2Qwerty v2, a non-invasive brain-scanning system that decodes full sentences with an average word accuracy of 61%, significantly outperforming previous non-invasive rivals' 8% high. The technology, trained on nearly 22,000 sentences from nine volunteers, approaches the accuracy levels of surgical implants while allowing for broader accessibility through open-sourced code.

items.title: 我讓三個 AI 各司其職寫程式：Codex 出測試、Grok 寫實作、Claude 驗收
items.summary: 作者通过让 Codex 编写测试、Grok 进行实作、Claude 独立验收的三阶段工作流，在 Zig 和 Rust + Turso 项目中验证了该分工模式的有效性。这种将“出题”与“施工”分离的方法利用严格测试作为契约，有效降低了单 Agent 自我验证带来的“假绿”风险及静默错误。尽管增加了协调成本，但在对正确性要求高于速度的场景下，该流程能显著提升代码交付质量。
items.why_now: 本周实测Codex、Grok、Claude三Agent协作编程，验证了多模型分工写代码的可行性。
items.summary_en: The author implemented a three-agent coding pipeline where Codex generates tests, Grok writes implementations to pass those fixed tests, and Claude performs independent verification. This workflow was validated across Zig and Rust projects, demonstrating that separating test generation from implementation reduces self-validation risks and catches silent errors that standard green-light checks might miss.

items.title: browser-use/video-use
items.summary: video-use 是一个开源视频编辑工具，通过与 Claude Code 等编程代理协作，利用 ElevenLabs Scribe 进行音频转录和分层视觉分析，实现去除填充词、自动调色及字幕烧录等功能。该方案通过将视频处理转化为结构化文本与少量图片，避免了直接分析数万帧画面带来的高额 Token 消耗，从而提升了编辑效率。用户只需将原始素材放入指定文件夹并发送指令，代理即可自动生成最终视频文件并提供自我评估优化。
items.why_now: browser-use发布开源视频剪辑Agent，支持Claude Code自动处理。
items.summary_en: video-use is an open-source tool that enables coding agents like Claude Code to edit videos by processing audio transcripts and visual composites rather than raw frames. It automates tasks such as removing filler words, auto-color grading, and adding subtitles, while utilizing ElevenLabs for transcription and self-evaluation loops to ensure quality. The system operates by converting video data into structured text and images, allowing the LLM to reason about cuts with word-boundary precision before rendering the final output.

items.title: xbtlin/ai-berkshire
items.summary: AI Berkshire 是基于 Claude Code 和 Codex 构建的价值投资研究框架，整合了巴菲特、芒格、段永平、李录四位大师的方法论，通过多 Agent 并行对抗分析实现专业级投研。该框架具备强制结论输出、结构化反偏见机制及金融数据精确校验能力，确保研究流程的可复现性与深度。实盘数据显示，其 2024 年全年收益为 +69.29%，2025 年至今收益为 +66.38%，两年累计实盘收益超 146 万元，大幅跑赢标普 500 及恒生指数等主要市场基准。
items.why_now: 2025年实盘收益+66.38%，验证AI投研框架有效性。
items.summary_en: AI Berkshire is a value investing research framework compatible with Claude Code and Codex that synthesizes methodologies from Buffett, Munger, Duan Yongping, and Li Lu using multi-agent parallel analysis. The system enforces structured decision-making through adversarial perspective checks, bias mitigation mechanisms, and precise financial verification, ensuring reproducible and actionable investment reports. Backed by real trading records showing +69.29% returns in 2024 and +66.38% year-to-date in 2025, it significantly outperformed major indices like the S&P 500 and Hang Seng Index.

items.title: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
items.summary: OmniRoute 是一个免费 AI 网关，通过单一端点连接 236 个提供商（含 50+ 免费），支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流编码工具。其核心采用 RTK+Caveman 压缩技术，可节省 15-95% 的 Token 消耗，并提供智能自动回退机制以避免限流。该平台聚合了约 16 亿免费 Token 额度，旨在解决多平台配额管理痛点并实现零成本接入。
items.why_now: OmniRoute聚合236家供应商及1.6B免费额度，为开发者提供一站式低成本AI接入方案。
items.summary_en: OmniRoute is a free AI gateway that aggregates access to 236 providers, including over 50 free options, through a single endpoint compatible with major coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor. It offers approximately 1.6 billion free tokens per month and utilizes RTK+Caveman stacked compression to reduce token usage by 15–95%. The service features smart auto-fallback to prevent rate limit interruptions and supports multimodal APIs via MCP and A2A protocols.

items.title: ogulcancelik/herdr
items.summary: herdr 是一个基于 Rust 开发的轻量级终端 Agent 多路复用器，旨在让用户在单一终端中同时运行和管理多个编码 Agent。它通过提供每个 Agent 独立的真实终端视图、实时的状态监控（阻塞/工作/完成）以及支持 SSH 远程连接和断线重连的功能，解决了传统 tmux 缺乏 Agent 感知能力以及 GUI 管理器兼容性差的问题。
items.why_now: herdr发布，单二进制实现终端内多Agent并行管理
items.summary_en: Herdr is a lightweight Rust-based agent multiplexer that allows users to run multiple coding agents in a single terminal with persistent sessions and real-time state visibility (blocked, working, done). It provides a native terminal experience with mouse support, panes, and tabs, ensuring agents survive detachment via a background server. The tool offers a local socket API for scripting and is available for Linux, macOS, and Windows Beta.

items.title: HKUDS/Vibe-Trading
items.summary: Vibe-Trading 是一个个人交易代理框架，支持通过 CLI、REST API 和 Web UI 管理会话，并内置 WebSocket、Telegram、Slack 等 16 种消息通道适配器。其核心功能包括基于 PreTradeAdvisoryInterface 的实时交易安全护栏、Trading 212 只读连接器以及针对 Windows 和 Gemini 模型的修复优化。该项目还强化了 Shadow Account 策略回测的精度，利用 RSI 和前期收益率等条件约束提升信号生成的真实性，并优化了 tushare 对 ETF、指数及港股的数据路由逻辑。
items.why_now: 2026年6月30日新增16种即时通讯渠道运行时支持。
items.summary_en: Vibe-Trading is a personal trading agent that empowers users with comprehensive capabilities through a single command and integrates with 16 built-in message adapters, including WebSocket, Telegram, and Discord. Recent updates introduce a broker-agnostic PreTradeAdvisoryInterface for live order safety, a read-only Trading 212 connector, and enhanced cross-platform setup for Windows. The platform also features improved Shadow Account logic with conditional entry bounds and refined data routing for ETFs and HK equities via Tushare.

items.title: Robbyant/lingbot-map
items.summary: LingBot-Map 是由 Robbyant Team 开发的流式 3D 重建前馈基础模型，采用几何上下文Transformer架构统一坐标定位与长程漂移校正。该模型利用分页 KV 注意力机制，在 518×378 分辨率下对超过 10,000 帧的长序列实现约 20 FPS 的稳定推理，性能优于现有的流式和迭代优化方案。
items.why_now: 2026年5月25日基准测试发布，长视频流处理性能显著提升。
items.summary_en: LingBot-Map is a feed-forward 3D foundation model by the Robbyant Team that achieves high-efficiency streaming inference at approximately 20 FPS for sequences exceeding 10,000 frames using a Geometric Context Transformer and paged KV cache attention. The model unifies coordinate grounding, dense geometric cues, and long-range drift correction to deliver state-of-the-art reconstruction performance on diverse benchmarks compared to existing streaming and iterative approaches.

items.title: 氪星晚报｜Kimi估值升至315亿美元，ARR突破3亿美元；优艾智合具身智能系列新品全球首发，3年赋能10000个工业现场；国家航天局：我国将建立近地小行星天地协同监测体系
items.summary: Kimi估值升至315亿美元，ARR突破3亿美元，其中API收入占比超7成，增长主要源于模型迭代带动的开发者使用及海外付费用户增加。优艾智合全球首发工业具身智能大模型“智合”及人形机器人“隙锋”，提出3年内赋能10000个工业现场的目标。
items.why_now: 英国CMA6月30日拟放宽苹果谷歌引流限制，开发者窗口期已现。
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI's Kimi has reached a pre-money valuation of $31.5 billion, with its Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) surpassing $300 million, driven primarily by API usage which now accounts for over 70% of total income. Concurrently, Youyizhihe launched its FabriX industrial embodied intelligence model, aiming to empower 10,000 industrial sites within three years while maintaining a global market share leadership in industrial mobile manipulation robots.

items.title: 美团 LongCat-2.0 正式发布：国产算力集群训练的万亿参数大模型
items.summary: 美团发布并开源了基于五万卡国产算力集群训练的万亿参数大模型LongCat-2.0，其总参数达1.6T，原生支持1M超长上下文。该模型采用LSA稀疏注意力及MOPD多专家融合架构，在SWE-bench Pro等评测中表现优异，且月调用量已跻身OpenRouter全球前三。
items.why_now: 6月30日美团发布LongCat-2.0，国产万亿模型正式开源。
items.summary_en: Meituan released and open-sourced LongCat-2.0, a trillion-parameter model trained on a 50,000-GPU domestic cluster, featuring native 1M context support and an ScMoE architecture. The model achieves high performance scores of 59.5 on SWE-bench Pro and 77.3 on SWE-bench Multilingual, while its preview version ranks in the top three globally on OpenRouter by monthly call volume.

items.title: mattpocockuk 的 /writing-great-skills：编写可预测 AI Skill 的指南
items.summary: @mattpocockuk 发布的 /writing-great-skills 旨在通过最小化且具行为牵引力的结构，将 AI Skill 编写为能稳定触发、分层加载的可预测工作流。其核心能力在于利用三层信息层级管理上下文注意力，并通过明确的完成标准和 leading word 解决模型提前结束或行为无效等问题。该工具支持通过 `npx skills add` 命令快速集成，显著提升了模型在特定任务中的行为一致性。
items.why_now: GitHub上@mattpocockuk刚发布编写高质量AI Skill的实战指南
items.summary_en: The `/writing-great-skills` repository by @mattpocockuk provides a framework for creating predictable AI Skills that minimize behavioral volatility through structured, layered loading and precise completion criteria. It distinguishes between `model-invoked` and `user-invoked` triggers, emphasizing that descriptions should function as activation conditions rather than introductions, while advocating for a three-tier information hierarchy to manage context attention. Key techniques include using "leading words" to compress behavioral requirements and implementing rigorous refactoring practices to eliminate redundancy, sediment, and no-op instructions.

items.title: 用 shot-scraper video 让 AI 智能体录制工作演示视频
items.summary: shot-scraper 1.10 版本新增 video 命令，基于 Playwright 1.61.0 的 screencast 机制，通过 storyboard.yml 文件定义操作步骤来录制浏览器视频，解决了旧版白帧和固定宽度问题。该工具允许编码 Agent 直接利用详细的 --help 输出自动生成如 Datasette 数据创建等演示视频，提升了自动化录制的准确性和效率。
items.why_now: 2026年6月30日shot-scraper v1.10发布，支持AI智能体自动生成工作演示视频。
items.summary_en: shot-scraper 1.10 introduces the `shot-scraper video` command, leveraging Playwright 1.61.0’s screencast mechanism to record browser videos via storyboard.yml files, resolving previous issues like white frames and fixed widths. This update enables AI agents to automatically generate demonstration videos, such as creating tables from CSV/TSV/JSON data in Datasette, by utilizing the tool's detailed `--help` output for direct code integration.

items.title: 黑石未来3~5年拟投300亿美元在日本建AI数据中心，联合成立AI XPV平台
items.summary: 黑石计划未来3至5年在日本追加投资300亿美元建设AI数据中心，新增超1GW容量，并联合阿波罗、博通成立AI XPV平台。该平台首期投入350亿美元，目标于2028年为OpenAI、Anthropic等企业提供超20GW算力，其中首期资金将支持Anthropic在Fluidstack数据中心部署1GW基础设施。
items.why_now: 黑石等巨头本月9日成立AI XPV平台，瞄准2028年算力供应。
items.summary_en: Blackstone plans to invest $30 billion in Japanese AI data centers over the next three to five years, adding over 1 GW of capacity to its existing 500 MW base. Additionally, Blackstone, Apollo, and Broadcom launched the AI XPV platform, targeting the provision of over 20 GW of computing power to OpenAI and Anthropic by 2028. The platform's initial $35 billion phase supports Anthropic’s deployment of 1 GW of infrastructure at Fluidstack data centers.

items.title: Ahmad Osman on why local AI is catching up
items.summary: Osmantic创始人Ahmad Osman在AI工程师世界博览会上展示其开源本地AI部署系统，强调通过DGX Spark、AMD Strix Halo等硬件及搜索工具集成，缩小了本地开源模型与闭源前沿模型4至8个月的能力差距。
items.why_now: AI工程师世界博览会凸显本地AI正快速追赶前沿模型。
items.summary_en: Ahmad Osman advocates for local AI through his open-source company Osmantic, highlighting that the performance gap between open-source models and proprietary frontier models has narrowed to just four to eight months. His recent workshops at the AI Engineer World’s Fair demonstrated tangible improvements in hardware capabilities, comparing systems like the DGX Spark and AMD Strix Halo against cloud models to showcase reduced latency and increased accessibility. Osman emphasizes that successful local AI requires comprehensive infrastructure beyond just running a model, including tool integration and search endpoints to match the functionality of hosted services.

items.title: Show HN: Sibyl – self-hosted cross-agent memory for AI coding agents
items.summary: Sibyl 是一款基于 SurrealDB 构建的高性能、可扩展的自托管跨代理记忆系统，支持通过 CLI 或 MCP 协议连接各类 AI 编程代理。其检索性能极具竞争力，在 LongMemEval-S 基准测试中严格召回率达到 96.96%，且检索路径中不包含大语言模型。该项目采用 Apache 2.0 许可证开源，当前版本已更新至 1.0.2，允许用户将项目笔记、文档及邮件等数据存储在自有基础设施中。
items.why_now: Sibyl刚发布1.0.2版，支持自托管AI编码代理记忆。
items.summary_en: Sibyl is an open-source, self-hosted cross-agent memory system built on SurrealDB that enables high-performance, parallel AI coding workflows. It achieves a 96.96% strict recall@5 on LongMemEval-S through efficient CLI/MCP integration and local storage, ensuring agents maintain context across projects without relying on external LLMs during retrieval.

items.title: Show HN: Turning Sentry errors into AI generated GitHub PRs with fixes
items.summary: 该工具利用 Sentry 捕获的错误信息，通过 AI 自动生成修复代码并创建对应的 GitHub Pull Request。这一流程实现了从错误监控到代码修复的自动化闭环，显著减少了手动排查和编写补丁的时间成本。
items.why_now: Show HN发布新工具，自动将Sentry错误转为GitHub修复PR。
items.summary_en: BugZero is a tool that automatically converts Sentry error reports into AI-generated GitHub pull requests containing code fixes. It streamlines debugging by leveraging artificial intelligence to analyze error logs and propose immediate solutions via version control integration.

items.title: Show HN: Mimir – local-first encrypted memory for AI agents (single Rust binary)
items.summary: Mimir 是一个基于 Rust 开发的单二进制文件工具，旨在为 AI 智能体提供本地优先的加密记忆存储。该项目通过单一可执行文件简化了部署流程，实现了数据在本地环境中的安全持久化管理。
items.why_now: Mimir作为本地优先加密AI记忆工具，为开发者提供新隐私解决方案。
items.summary_en: Mimir is a local-first, encrypted memory solution for AI agents distributed as a single Rust binary. It prioritizes privacy and data security by keeping agent memory on-device rather than relying on external cloud services. The project is open-source and available on GitHub under Perseus Computing LLC.

items.title: ScarfBench: Benchmarking AI Agents for Enterprise Java Framework Migration
items.summary: ScarfBench是一个用于评估AI智能体在企业Java框架迁移任务中性能的综合基准测试。该研究重点考察了不同AI工具在代码转换准确性、依赖处理及整体工程效率方面的核心能力表现。通过量化分析，为开发者选择适合自动化迁移复杂遗留系统的AI解决方案提供了关键参考依据。
items.why_now: 无明确时效信号
items.summary_en: ScarfBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate AI agents' capabilities in migrating enterprise Java frameworks. It focuses on assessing how effectively these agents can handle complex technical transitions within professional software development environments.

items.title: Show HN: Morph Reflexes – Multi-head classifiers for agent traces
items.summary: Morph Reflexes 是基于 vLLM 分支构建的多头分类器，通过共享主干和 KV 缓存复用机制，实现了亚 30 毫秒的低延迟推理及每增加一个反射头不到 2 毫秒的极低开销。该技术利用混合注意力机制移除解码步骤，以远低于前沿模型的成本和速度从 Agent 轨迹中提取语义信号，解决了大规模生产环境中监控用户挫败感等行为问题的扩展性难题。
items.why_now: Morph推出多分类器API，实现亚30毫秒极速推理，专为Agent规模化监控设计。
items.summary_en: Morph Reflexes is an API-first tool that extracts semantic signals from agent traces using a multi-head classifier architecture forked from vLLM, enabling sub-30ms inference with negligible overhead per additional head. By sharing a single backbone and reusing KV/cache across inputs, it offers a cost-effective alternative to expensive frontier LLM judges for monitoring behaviors like looping or user frustration at scale.

items.title: I ported Kubernetes to the browser
items.summary: 该项目将 Kubernetes 成功移植至浏览器环境中运行。这一技术突破使得用户无需本地部署即可在 Web 端直接操作和管理集群资源。
items.why_now: Kubernetes 已移植至浏览器，为前端云原生开发开辟新路径。
items.summary_en: The author successfully ported Kubernetes to run directly within a web browser environment. This technical achievement demonstrates the feasibility of container orchestration in client-side applications without requiring traditional server infrastructure.

items.title: Run any Dockerfile on Vercel
items.summary: Vercel 允许开发者在平台上运行任意 Dockerfile，突破了原有构建系统的限制。这一功能使得自定义环境配置和复杂依赖管理成为可能，提升了部署的灵活性。
items.why_now: Vercel发布新功能支持运行任意Dockerfile
items.summary_en: Vercel now supports running custom Dockerfiles, allowing developers to deploy arbitrary containerized applications alongside its traditional serverless functions. This update enables the use of persistent backends and custom runtimes that were previously unsupported on the platform.

items.title: CalcMora just crossed 200 tools | Here's what changed under the hood
items.summary: CalcMora 已上线 200 款计算器与转换器，目标是在一年内扩展至 3,000 款。该平台采用基于 Astro 和 Cloudflare Pages 的静态技术栈，通过统一的页面模板和结构化数据实现规模化生产与高搜索排名。此外，新增的可嵌入小部件功能允许其他网站零配置接入这些轻量级工具，进一步拓展了分发渠道。
items.why_now: CalcMora上线可嵌入工具功能，助力开发者快速分发。
items.summary_en: CalcMora has launched 200 static calculators and converters using an Astro and Cloudflare Pages stack, aiming for 3,000 tools by year-end. The platform ensures scalability through consistent templates, schema.org markup, and a new embeddable widget system that allows site owners to integrate lightweight, ad-free tools via simple copy-paste snippets.

items.title: 客戶開價太低嗎？Freelancer 接案前的 3 問決策樹
items.summary: 文章提出 Freelancer 接案前的“3问决策树”，通过核算覆盖实际时间成本的每小时时薪、评估需求清晰度以控制风险溢价，以及判断是否具备后续项目或战略客户价值来辅助定价决策。文中通过 $200 改 CSS 和 $2,000 开发登录系统等真实案例，揭示了理解代码库、环境配置及沟通等隐藏成本，指出低报价往往导致时薪低于生存底线。最后提供快速检查表供从业者自查，并建议若需具体报价审查可联系作者获取分析。
items.why_now: 無明確時效性信號
items.summary_en: The article outlines a three-question decision tree for freelancers to evaluate low-ball offers by calculating effective hourly rates against baseline survival costs, assessing risk from vague requirements, and determining strategic value through future projects or portfolio impact. It highlights that hidden costs like debugging legacy code and communication often turn seemingly simple tasks into unprofitable endeavors. The author also offers a paid service for individual quote reviews and references a comprehensive pricing master index for further guidance.

items.title: Introducing correctover-patronus: 6-Dimensional Verification for Patronus AI
items.summary: correctover-patronus 是将 Correctover 的 87 条确定性验证规则集成到 Patronus AI 的适配器，涵盖结构、Schema、语义、完整性、延迟及成本六维检测。该方案在本地执行且无外部 API 调用，P50 验证延迟低至 22μs，并为每次评估生成可复现的证明哈希。
items.why_now: correctover-patronus适配器发布，集成Patronus AI实现LLM结构化验证。
items.summary_en: correctover-patronus is an adapter that integrates Correctover’s 87 deterministic verification rules into Patronus AI, enabling six-dimensional checks for structure, schema, identity, integrity, latency, and cost. It provides a fully local, zero-API solution with a P50 verification latency of 22μs and generates recomputable proof hashes for every evaluation verdict.

items.title: From Vibe Coding to Production: A Step-by-Step Guide to Shipping AI-Generated Code Safely in 2026
items.summary: 针对AI生成的代码从原型到生产环境部署的差距，指南提出了包括结构审查和添加真实测试层在内的具体加固步骤。通过纠正SQL注入等安全漏洞并覆盖过期令牌等边缘情况，开发者能有效提升代码在生产环境中的稳定性与安全性。
items.why_now: 2026年AI生成代码投产鸿沟扩大，生产级交付成新核心竞争力。
items.summary_en: The article highlights the critical gap between rapid AI-generated prototypes and production-ready code, emphasizing that speed of generation does not equate to system reliability. It provides a step-by-step guide for developers to safely ship AI-generated code by treating outputs as drafts, conducting structural reviews for security vulnerabilities like SQL injection, and implementing robust test suites that cover failure modes.

items.title: Taming the AI Agent: A Developer's Guide to Better Prompting
items.summary: 文章指出AI响应质量取决于提示词工程，建议开发者通过定义角色、提供上下文、明确任务及添加约束四大要素优化指令。文中列举了逐步提示、少样本提示和迭代提示等技巧，以引导ChatGPT、Claude等工具生成更精准、结构化的代码与解释，从而提升开发效率。
items.why_now: 无明确时效性
items.summary_en: Effective prompt engineering requires structuring instructions around four key components: defining a specific role, providing project context, clearly describing the task, and adding constraints. Advanced techniques such as step-by-step, few-shot, and iterative prompting further enhance accuracy by guiding the AI through logical reasoning and pattern recognition. These methods transform generic AI interactions into precise, production-ready outcomes for developers using tools like ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot.

items.title: How We Process 7,500 Product Images Daily Without Breaking the Pipeline
items.summary: 该团队通过引入“复杂度分类”阶段，将产品图片按边缘复杂度和颜色匹配风险分为简单、中等和复杂三类，并分别路由至自动化处理或人工审核队列。这种混合工作流确保了日均处理 7,500 张电商图片时的稳定性，有效避免了因 AI 自动抠图在珠宝、蕾丝等复杂场景下的错误导致的亚马逊Listing被拒或客户退货率上升。
items.why_now: 无明确时效性信号
items.summary_en: The workflow processes 7,500 daily product images by routing simple items through an automated pipeline while sending complex products to human editors. Key stages include format normalization, complexity classification based on edge and color risks, and final RGB verification to prevent marketplace rejection errors.

items.title: usestrix/strix
items.summary: Strix 是一款开源自主 AI 渗透测试工具，支持 gpt-5.4 等主流大模型，通过动态运行代码和生成真实概念验证（PoC）来发现并修复应用漏洞。它具备多智能体编排、自动修复及 CI/CD 集成能力，能显著减少静态分析带来的误报，将渗透测试周期从数周缩短至数小时。
items.why_now: Strix开源，集成GitHub Actions，自动扫描修复漏洞。
items.summary_en: Strix is an open-source AI penetration testing tool that uses autonomous agents to dynamically find, validate, and fix application vulnerabilities, integrating seamlessly with GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipelines. It features a comprehensive toolkit including HTTP interception, browser exploitation, and shell execution to generate working proofs-of-concept and auto-fixes for issues like broken access control. Users can install via a simple CLI command requiring Docker and an LLM API key, or utilize the free web platform at app.strix.ai for continuous security scanning.

items.title: altic-dev/FluidVoice
items.summary: FluidVoice 是一款基于 macOS 的开源语音转文字应用，支持 Nemotron Speech 3.5、Parakeet Flash 及 Whisper 等多种本地语音模型。其核心亮点“Fluid Intelligence”提供了完全本地的 AI 增强功能，实现智能格式化、上下文感知的大小写修正及后处理，确保数据零上传。此外，该应用还具备命令模式和控制模式，允许用户通过语音直接操作 Mac 系统或在任意文本框中实时书写。
items.why_now: FluidVoice 1.6.0发布，实现零延迟本地语音转文字。
items.summary_en: FluidVoice is an open-source macOS dictation app featuring the new 1.6.0 release, which includes a rebuilt Parakeet implementation for near-zero latency and a fully local "Fluid Intelligence" AI model for on-device text enhancement. It supports multiple speech models such as Nemotron Speech 3.5 and Whisper, offering both Command Mode for system control and Write Mode for inline text generation without sending data to the cloud.

items.title: Claude Science is Anthropic’s newest flagship product
items.summary: Anthropic 发布旗舰产品 Claude Science，供所有付费订阅用户使用，旨在通过自主执行代码和在强大计算集群上运行任务来支持计算生物学和药物研发。该产品强调可重复性，其背后的 Opus 4.5 模型据哈佛物理学家评估，具备执行科学项目的研究生水平能力。随着前 DeepMind 研究员 John Jumper 加入，Anthropic 正加速在 AI 科学领域的发展。
items.why_now: Anthropic周二发布Claude Science，AI科研产品竞争格局生变。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Science, a standalone product for paid subscribers designed to autonomously support computational biology and drug development through code execution on computer clusters and reproducible results. Positioned as a direct competitor to Google DeepMind’s AlphaFold, the tool leverages Anthropic’s Opus models to perform tasks comparable to those of a second-year graduate student.

items.title: ripienaar/free-for-dev
items.summary: ripienaar/free-for-dev 是一个由超过 1600 人协作维护的开源列表，专门收录面向基础设施开发者（如 DevOps、系统管理员）的免费 SaaS、PaaS 和 IaaS 服务。该清单详细列出了包括 Google Cloud Platform 在内的主要云厂商提供的永久免费额度，例如 GCP 的 App Engine 每日 28 小时前端实例、Cloud Firestore 每日 1GB 存储及 BigQuery 每月 1TB 查询量等具体资源限制。
items.why_now: 该列表由1600+人维护，持续更新免费资源，是开发者低成本起步的实时情报源。
items.summary_en: The GitHub repository ripienaar/free-for-dev compiles a curated list of SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS offerings with permanent free tiers, specifically targeting infrastructure developers. Maintained by over 1,600 contributors, the resource excludes self-hosted software and trials, focusing instead on services like Google Cloud Platform and AWS that provide lasting free access to tools such as Compute Engine, Cloud Firestore, and BigQuery.

items.title: google/agents-cli
items.summary: google/agents-cli 是一款能将 Claude Code、Codex 等任意编程助手转化为专家级工具，用于在 Google Cloud 及 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 上构建、评估和部署企业级 AI Agent 的命令行接口。它通过提供包括项目脚手架、ADK Python API、自动化评估及多环境部署在内的全套技能，使用户无需单独学习各项 CLI 和服务即可实现 Agent 的全生命周期管理。
items.why_now: Google发布agents-cli，赋能开发者快速构建企业级AI Agent。
items.summary_en: google/agents-cli is a tool that equips coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex with specialized skills to build, evaluate, and deploy enterprise-grade AI agents on Google Cloud. It integrates with the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, offering commands for scaffolding, evaluation using LLM-as-judge metrics, and deployment via Cloud Run or GKE.

items.title: facebook/astryx
items.summary: Astryx 是 Meta 内部使用八年、支撑 13,000+ 应用的开源设计系统，基于 React 和 StyleX 构建。该系统提供 150+ 个无障碍组件、CLI 工具及七种预设主题，支持通过 npm 安装并无需配置构建插件即可直接使用。其核心优势在于开放的内部组件逻辑、无样式锁定以及为人类开发者和 AI 助手统一设计的 API 与文档规范。
items.why_now: Meta开源内部8年最火设计系统Astryx，适配AI协作。
items.summary_en: Astryx is an open-source React design system built on StyleX that powers over 13,000 applications and provides 150+ accessible components with zero build-plugin configuration. It features fully customizable theming and a unified CLI interface designed to enable consistent development for both human engineers and AI agents.

items.title: hasaneyldrm/exercises-dataset
items.summary: 该数据集包含1,324个健身动作的元数据及多语言（英、西、意、土、俄、中）分步说明，源自ExerciseDB v1并进行了格式清洗。它专为构建健身应用后端、机器学习推荐系统或健康研究提供结构化数据支持，涵盖类别、目标肌群及设备需求等字段。需注意，原始媒体文件（缩略图及动画）因版权原因未包含在内，仅保留媒体ID供引用。
items.why_now: 无明确时效信号
items.summary_en: The hasaneyldrm/exercises-dataset provides a structured collection of 1,324 fitness exercises with metadata and step-by-step instructions translated into six languages (English, Spanish, Italian, Turkish, Russian, and Chinese). Sourced from ExerciseDB v1, the repository includes developer setup tools and an interactive browser but excludes media assets due to ownership disputes. It is designed for building fitness applications, machine learning projects, and health research.

items.title: microsoft/AI-For-Beginners
items.summary: Microsoft推出的“AI for Beginners”课程包含12周、24节课，涵盖TensorFlow和PyTorch等工具及AI伦理。该资源支持50多种语言翻译，并提供通过稀疏检出（sparse checkout）快速克隆仓库的技术指南。
items.why_now: 微软发布12周AI初学者课程
items.summary_en: Microsoft’s AI-For-Beginners is a free, 12-week curriculum comprising 24 lessons that teach foundational AI concepts, including neural networks and deep learning, using TensorFlow and PyTorch. The resource is highly accessible, offering automated multi-language support for over 50 languages and optimized cloning methods to manage download sizes. It focuses on practical implementation and ethics while explicitly excluding advanced business cases, classic machine learning, and deep mathematics.

items.title: 苏大教授创业做机器人触觉系统，获松禾资本千万级天使轮融资｜硬氪首发
items.summary: 感知纪元完成由松禾资本领衔的千万级天使轮融资，资金将用于加速多模态智能触觉电子皮肤从研发走向量产。该公司核心产品采用全弹性仿生材料，单张皮肤可覆盖机器人全身，支持400%以上拉伸及压力、温度等多模态信号毫秒级同步采集，并通过内置迁移学习算法实现从感知到理解的闭环。目前，其已与国内头部人形机器人公司达成战略合作，并获得多家新能源汽车及护理机器人企业的千万级采购意向。
items.why_now: 2025年12月成立的公司刚获千万融资，抢占机器人触觉落地窗口期。
items.summary_en: Perception Epoch completed a tens-of-millions-yuan angel financing led by Songhe Capital to accelerate the mass production of its multimodal intelligent tactile electronic skin. The company’s core product is a highly elastic bionic electronic skin capable of covering entire robot bodies, integrating pressure, sliding, temperature, texture, and deformation sensing with millisecond-level response and 400%+ stretchability. Backed by founder Liu Ruiyuan’s expertise from Soochow University and industry partnerships with top humanoid robot and EV manufacturers, the solution addresses critical gaps in complex physical environment adaptation and fine motor control.

items.title: 8点1氪丨“史上最严电池安全令”正式施行；苹果大量机密文件遭泄露；OpenAI首款硬件曝光
items.summary: 7月1日起，电动汽车新国标正式实施，强制要求“一键断电”装置为物理断电且电池需满足不起火、不爆炸的热扩散标准。Anthropic发布Claude Science科研工作台以整合AI代理分析流程，其模型Fable的出口管制预计解除；OpenAI则曝光首款硬件为与Work Louder联名的可编程宏键盘。Kimi估值升至315亿美元，其ARR突破3亿美元且API收入占比超七成，寒武纪成为科创板首支万亿市值公司。
items.why_now: 7月1日电池安全新规施行，独立开发者需关注合规与接口调整。
items.summary_en: China implemented strict new battery safety standards on July 1, mandating physical emergency power-off devices and prohibiting fire or explosion during thermal runaway tests. Meanwhile, Apple faced a significant data breach involving iPhone 18 Pro details leaked via ransomware, while OpenAI unveiled its first hardware product, a programmable macro keyboard designed to enhance Codex efficiency.

items.title: AI 用 prover-verifier LLM 循环攻克 9 个未解数学难题
items.summary: 该研究通过“证明者-验证者”大语言模型循环框架，成功攻克了理论计算机科学中的9个重大未解问题。这一突破性进展不仅解决了包括作者长期关注在内的多个难题，更显著提升了LLM在通用数学研究领域的核心能力，使其超越了以往仅解决单一问题的局限。
items.why_now: 该方法攻克9道难题，拟扩展至全科学领域。
items.summary_en: A "prover-verifier" Large Language Model loop successfully solved nine major unsolved problems in theoretical computer science, including one that had remained open for two years. This framework, developed by researchers from Columbia University, has shifted expert perspectives on the capacity of LLMs to conduct general mathematical research. The team plans to extend this methodology to other scientific disciplines.

items.title: Acti 将 AI 智能体直接放入手机键盘
items.summary: Acti 推出基于 Google Gemini 的 AI 智能体键盘，通过本地优先架构保障隐私，利用自然语言创建“Skills”实现长按翻译或发送链接等应用内操作。早期测试者两周内创建了超过 1000 个 Skills，验证了该工具的高效复用性。该公司已获 530 万美元种子轮融资并开放下载。
items.why_now: 2026年6月30日Acti上线，AI智能体首入手机键盘。
items.summary_en: Singaporean startup Acti has released an AI agent keyboard based on Google Gemini that allows users to execute app actions via natural language commands called "Skills." The platform features a privacy-focused local-first architecture and saw early testers create over 1,000 skills within two weeks. Following a $5.3 million seed round led by BITKRAFT Ventures, the keyboard is now available for download.

items.title: Claude Science 科研工作台正式上线
items.summary: Anthropic 发布 AI 科研工作台 Claude Science，提供超 60 项预配置技能，覆盖基因组学及蛋白质组学等领域，并支持在 macOS/Linux 本地或 HPC 远程运行。该平台通过 NVIDIA BioNeMo 接入 Evo 2 等模型，内置 reviewer agent 自动核查引用与计算错误，确保生成含代码的可审计成果。目前该工具以 beta 版形式向 Claude Pro、Max、Team 及 Enterprise 用户开放。
items.why_now: Claude Science今日上线Beta，专为科研人员打造全流程AI工作台。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launched the beta version of Claude Science, an AI research workbench offering over 60 pre-configured skills for fields like genomics and structural biology, available to Claude Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise users. The platform supports local macOS/Linux execution or remote SSH/HPC access, integrating models such as Evo 2 and Boltz-2 via NVIDIA BioNeMo while generating auditable outputs with automated review agents.

items.title: Claude Sonnet 5 发布
items.summary: Anthropic 发布具备自主计划、浏览器及终端操作能力的 Claude Sonnet 5，其性能接近 Opus 4.8 且定价更低，限时输入单价为 2 美元/百万 token。该模型在推理、编程及智能体任务上较 Sonnet 4.6 有显著提升，并在 BrowseComp 和 OSWorld-Verified 评测中严格优于前代版本。目前已在所有套餐、Claude Code 及 Claude API 中全面上线。
items.why_now: Anthropic推出Claude Sonnet 5，限时低价至2026年8月，性能强劲且支持自主运行。
items.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5, an autonomous agent model with planning, browser, and terminal capabilities that significantly outperforms Sonnet 4.6 in reasoning and coding while closely matching Opus 4.8’s performance. The model offers a promotional pricing rate of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens until August 31, 2026, before reverting to standard rates. It is immediately available across all subscription tiers, Claude Code, and the Claude API.

items.title: Claude Code 入门：智能体循环
items.summary: Claude Code 定义了智能体循环为 Agent 重复工作直至满足停止条件的过程，涵盖 turn-based、goal-based、time-based 及 proactive 四种类型。通过 `/goal` 命令可设定可验证的完成标准与最大轮次，利用 `/loop` 和 `/schedule` 支持按时间间隔重复执行及云端调度。此外，编写 SKILL.md 文件能将人工验证步骤编码以实现端到端自检，从而减少 turn-based 循环中的手动操作。
items.why_now: Anthropic发布Claude Code智能体循环新API，提升自动化效率。
items.summary_en: Claude Code defines agent loops as repetitive processes until a stop condition is met, categorizing them into turn-based, goal-based (using `/goal`), time-based (using `/loop`/`/schedule`), and proactive types. The framework allows users to encode manual verification steps via `SKILL.md` files, enabling Claude to perform end-to-end self-checks and reduce reliance on turn-based interactions.

items.title: ADK Go 2.0 发布：构建可靠的多智能体应用，新增基于图的工作流引擎、人工参与循环与动态编排
items.summary: Go 版本的 Agent Development Kit (ADK) 2.0 发布，引入了基于图的工作流引擎以支持复杂多智能体应用的组合。新版本新增人工参与循环（HITL）、纯 Go 代码动态执行及指数退避重试等特性，并通过统一执行模型简化了遥测与状态管理。
items.why_now: Google ADK Go 2.0发布，新增图工作流与人工参与。
items.summary_en: Google released ADK for Go 2.0, introducing a graph-based workflow engine to build complex multi-agent applications with unified runtime execution. The update features human-in-the-loop orchestration, dynamic execution via pure Go code, and automatic resilience through exponential backoff retries.

items.title: Google DeepMind 发布 Nano Banana 2 Lite 和 Gemini Omni Flash
items.summary: Google DeepMind 发布 Nano Banana 2 Lite，这是其速度最快且成本最低的图像模型，文本转图像仅需 4 秒，每 1K 分辨率成本为 0.034 美元，已接入 Google AI Studio 及 Gemini API 等产品。同时推出的 Gemini Omni Flash 支持高画质视频生成与对话式编辑，视频输出定价为每秒 0.10 美元，并面向开发者开放 API。
items.why_now: Google DeepMind刚发布极速低价图像API，开发者现可低成本接入。
items.summary_en: Google DeepMind launched Nano Banana 2 Lite, its fastest and cheapest image model, generating text-to-image outputs in just 4 seconds at $0.034 per 1K resolution. Additionally, it introduced Gemini Omni Flash for high-quality video generation and conversational editing, priced at $0.10 per second via API access.

items.title: The AI Compass
items.summary: 该文章介绍了一款名为“The AI Compass”的在线测试工具，由开发者bambamramfan制作，旨在通过回答29个关于人工智能及其伦理的问题，将用户归类至30种原型之一。技术实现上，该项目采用单页React应用架构，并利用`<script type="text/babel">`技巧避免了构建步骤。
items.summary_en: The AI Compass is a political-style quiz created by bambamramfan that categorizes users into one of 30 AI archetypes based on their responses to 29 questions regarding AI and ethics. The application is built as a single-page React app utilizing the `<script type="text/babel">` technique to bypass the standard build step.

items.title: The twilight of the chatbots
items.summary: 前沿模型如Opus 4.7和Fable展现出极强的自主工作能力，前者在14小时内构建了需人类2-17周完成的项目（成本251美元），后者9小时执行了超团队一周的工作量。与此同时，中国开源权重模型虽落后美国封闭模型6-12个月，但同样处于指数级提升曲线中且运营成本更低。随着AI能执行更长任务，使用方式正从“协同智能”向无需持续干预的长期自主系统转变。
items.summary_en: Leading US models like Claude and GPT-5.6, alongside near-frontier Chinese open-weight models, are demonstrating exponential capability gains, with systems such as Opus 4.7 building software packages equivalent to 2–17 weeks of human work in under 14 hours for $251. This rapid improvement in autonomous task execution is shifting usage patterns away from traditional co-intelligence prompting toward long-running, self-correcting AI systems that require minimal human intervention.

items.title: shot-scraper 1.10
items.summary: shot-scraper 1.10 版本新增了 video storyboard.yml 功能，支持通过该配置文件记录视频演示。该功能允许智能体自动录制其工作过程的视频示例，并已在相关文档中详细说明。
items.summary_en: shot-scraper version 1.10 introduces support for generating video storyboards via the `shot-scraper video storyboard.yml` command. This update enables agents to automatically record video demonstrations of their operational workflows.

items.title: AIEWF Daily Dispatch: Loops, Software Factories & Forward Deployed Engineers
items.summary: AIEWF大会聚焦“循环”与“软件工厂”，OpenAI的Codex及微软Foundry等案例展示了通过多智能体循环协作提升生产力的趋势。该模式强调将AI编码代理转化为持续运行的持久工作者，实现从代码生成到部署的全生命周期自动化。这一范式旨在让开发者构建“能构建产品的系统”，从而加速软件工程向工厂化工程转型。
items.summary_en: The AI Engineer World’s Fair highlighted "loops" and "software factories" as central themes, featuring discussions on Microsoft’s Foundry, OpenAI’s Codex, and Warp’s pivot toward autonomous development platforms. Speakers emphasized that iterative agent loops and human-in-the-loop orchestration significantly enhance productivity by automating the entire software lifecycle, from coding to deployment. This shift positions software engineering as a form of factory engineering, where systems autonomously build products while managing feedback and prioritization.

items.title: Show HN: The Sword of Ghix – a retro game made by a 13 yo with AI Assisted tools
items.summary: 13岁开发者利用VS Code、Claude Code及Godot MCP构建了一套AI辅助编程工作流，在数周内独立完成了复古游戏《The Sword of Ghix》第一章的开发。该案例展示了通过整合特定AI工具链，具备基础Python/JavaScript知识的青少年即可高效实现复杂项目落地。
items.summary_en: A 13-year-old developer created the first chapter of "The Sword of Ghix," a retro game, using a workflow combining VS Code, Claude Code, and Godot MCP. Leveraging his existing knowledge of Python and JavaScript, he completed the project in just a few weeks through an AI-assisted pipeline.

items.title: Show HN: Live face swap and outfit try-on in the browser
items.summary: 该工具基于 Vivify.video 技术，实现了在浏览器端实时进行人脸替换和服装试穿。其核心能力在于无需后端服务器即可在客户端完成高性能的视觉生成，显著降低了部署门槛并提升了隐私安全性。
items.summary_en: Vivify.video offers a browser-based tool for live face swapping and virtual outfit try-ons without requiring server-side processing. The platform utilizes client-side WebAssembly and WebGL technologies to enable real-time performance directly within the user's browser.

items.title: Show HN: Coding agent that compiles intent into deterministic DAG before running
items.summary: Rigorix 是一款编码智能体，其核心技术在于在运行前将用户意图编译为确定性的有向无环图（DAG）。该方案通过结构化执行流程，提升了代码生成的确定性与可靠性，区别于传统线性或随机性的 Agent 工作流。
items.summary_en: Rigorix is a coding agent that converts user intent into a deterministic Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) prior to execution. This approach ensures structured and reliable code generation by establishing a fixed workflow before running the actual tasks.

items.title: Show HN: TakoVM – open-source sandboxing for your agent's code
items.summary: TakoVM 是一个开源的沙箱化解决方案，旨在安全地执行 AI Agent 的代码。该项目由 Tako-Research 发布，托管于 GitHub，目前获得 4 个点赞且暂无评论。
items.summary_en: TakoVM is an open-source sandboxing solution designed to securely execute agent code, available via its GitHub repository at Tako-Research/TakoVM. The project currently has low community engagement on Hacker News, with only 4 points and zero comments recorded. It addresses security needs for AI agents by providing a contained environment for code execution.

items.title: Wayve launches $85M employee tender offer at $8.5B valuation
items.summary: AI初创公司Wayve以85亿美元估值发起8500万美元的员工股份回购要约。此举旨在通过股权流动性激励吸引并留住人才，反映了AI领域利用员工收购作为战略工具的日益增长的趋势。
items.summary_en: Wayve launched an $85 million employee tender offer valued at $8.5 billion to attract and retain talent amidst a growing trend among AI startups. This strategic move highlights the company's significant market valuation and its focus on securing key personnel through financial incentives.

items.title: Nvidia competitor Etched hits $5B valuation, $1B in sales for AI chip
items.summary: Etched 作为 Nvidia 的竞争对手，其估值已达 50 亿美元。该公司已为基于自研芯片的推理系统签订了 10 亿美元的合同订单。
items.summary_en: Etched, an Nvidia competitor in the AI chip sector, has achieved a $5 billion valuation after booking $1 billion in contracts for its inference systems. The company's technology leverages its proprietary chips to power these high-demand AI inference solutions.

items.title: Nobody wants to review the robot's 600-line pull request
items.summary: 2026年AI代理生成的代码虽质量高且测试通过，但导致代码审查成为团队瓶颈，审查深度因时间压力被迫降级为表面通过。由于缺乏人类开发者间的共享上下文，审查者难以从代码中重构代理意图，极易遗漏基于系统历史背景的逻辑错误。这种由审查能力无法匹配生成速度引发的治理失效，正以隐性风险的形式在多个团队中蔓延。
items.summary_en: AI agents in 2026 generate high-quality, well-tested code rapidly, shifting the primary engineering bottleneck from writing to reviewing. This surge in volume forces teams to downgrade deep reviews into superficial skims, creating governance risks as reviewers struggle to reconstruct the missing intent behind fluent, autonomous diffs.

items.title: ♟️ Why Can’t Incumbents Copy You (Even When They Obviously Should)?
items.summary: 文章指出 incumbent（行业巨头）无法轻易复制初创公司，是因为模仿会摧毁其现有商业模式并暴露其市场误判，这被称为“反定位”策略。成功的反定位需攻击对手的商业模型、将其困于两难选择，并锚定真实的客户需求以提供更高价值。此外，文中还推荐了 HeadsUp 等 AI 竞争情报工具及通过“事前验尸”练习优化决策的方法。
items.summary_en: Incumbents struggle to copy startups because doing so would undermine their existing business models and damage their profit margins. Successful counter-positioning requires anchoring a new model to genuine customer needs while attacking the incumbent's structure, as demonstrated by Vanguard’s lower-fee approach. This strategy traps incumbents in a dilemma where copying the innovator means admitting prior market misjudgments and sacrificing their own financial stability.

items.title: 视频版Nano Banana来了！内置Gemini世界知识；原版香蕉出图仅需4秒
items.summary: 视频版 Nano Banana 内置 Gemini 世界知识，显著提升了内容生成的智能水平。其原版功能实现了极速出图，单次生成仅需 4 秒。
items.summary_en: Nano Banana is a video generation tool that integrates Gemini's world knowledge to enhance output quality. The original version of the tool achieves image generation speeds of just four seconds per output.

items.title: Claude Code is steganographically marking requests
items.summary: Claude Code 通过隐写术在请求中嵌入标记，旨在追踪用户身份以优化服务或执行策略。该技术利用提示词工程中的隐蔽信息传递机制，在不影响正常功能的前提下实现请求溯源。
items.summary_en: Claude Code employs steganography to embed hidden markers within its API requests, allowing Anthropic to identify and potentially penalize users who attempt to bypass safety guidelines. This technique enables the company to track prompt injection attempts and enforce usage policies by detecting these covert signals in the transmitted data.

items.title: 早报｜苹果iPhone 18 Pro大规模泄露/SK海力士启动赴美IPO/Claude Sonnet 5正式上线
items.summary: Anthropic发布Claude Sonnet 5，通过强化AI Agent自主规划与工具调用能力，在编程基准测试中取得63.2%的高分，并以每百万Token 2至10美元的定价大幅降低开发者运行成本。与此同时，月之暗面Kimi新一轮融资投前估值升至315亿美元，其API收入占比超七成，6月中旬ARR已突破3亿美元。
items.summary_en: Apple's Indian supplier Tata Electronics suffered a massive data breach involving over 200,000 confidential files regarding the iPhone 18 Pro, including schematics for the A20 chip and component lists. Meanwhile, Anthropic launched Claude Sonnet 5, a new AI agent model designed to reduce operational costs while achieving performance levels comparable to its more expensive predecessors.

items.title: 赤子城独家投资：4人创业团队「MobAI」，推出AI互动平台「Lunaverse Stories」 | 36氪首发
items.summary: MobAI完成数百万元天使轮融资，由赤子城科技独家投资，其推出的AI互动叙事应用Lunaverse Stories已进入邀请制测试阶段。该产品针对北美18至24岁女性用户，通过“Remix Anywhere”和“Dream Universe”两大核心AI系统实现剧情实时生成与个性化推荐，区别于传统预设剧情。团队计划于二季度中旬正式上线APP，并同步推出支持AI辅助编剧的创作者工具Lunaverse IDE。
items.summary_en: MobAI secured angel funding from Chisecity Technology to develop Lunaverse Stories, an AI-driven interactive narrative app targeting North American women aged 18–24. The platform utilizes core systems like "Remix Anywhere" and "Dream Universe" to generate personalized storylines based on real-time user choices and dice-roll mechanics. With the IDE already open to creators and the main app scheduled for mid-year launch, the team is leveraging AI to redefine traditional interactive fiction through hyper-personalization.

items.title: 松下计划进一步拓展人工智能业务，在未来两个财年投资约5000亿日元
items.summary: 松下宣布在未来两个财年投资约5000亿日元拓展人工智能业务，旨在通过行业合作实现约1.4万亿日元的AI基础设施相关销售额。与此同时，该公司将裁员规模扩大至1.2万人，预计2024财年可节省1450亿日元成本。
items.summary_en: Panasonic plans to invest approximately 500 billion yen over the next two fiscal years to expand its AI infrastructure business, targeting sales of around 1.4 trillion yen within three years. To support this strategic shift away from home appliances, the company is increasing its layoff target to 12,000 workers, expecting to save 145 billion yen by fiscal 2024.

items.title: AOL母公司Bending Spoons的16.8亿美元IPO定价高于指导区间
items.summary: AOL母公司Bending Spoons完成IPO，以每股29.00美元的定价募资16.8亿美元，高于26.00-28.00美元指导区间。此次发行后公司估值达到约180亿美元。
items.summary_en: Italian-based company Bending Spoons priced its IPO at $29.00 per share, exceeding the initial guidance range of $26.00–$28.00. The offering raised $1.68 billion and values the firm, parent of AOL, at approximately $18 billion.

items.title: Anthropic在Claude Code中植入隐写术代码识别中国用户
items.summary: Anthropic在Claude Code中利用读取本地时区和环境变量，结合加密域名列表识别中国用户，并通过替换Unicode字符将2-3比特分类标记隐蔽传回服务器。该技术细节经社区逆向发现后引发争议，被认为破坏了用户信任。
items.summary_en: Anthropic embedded steganography in Claude Code to identify Chinese users by analyzing local time zones and environment variables against an encrypted domain list. The tool alters Unicode characters in system prompt dates to transmit classification markers back to servers, a covert mechanism discovered via reverse engineering. This undisclosed tracking has sparked community controversy and damaged user trust.

items.title: 库克与欧盟科技主管就新版Siri AI举行建设性会谈
items.summary: 苹果CEO库克与欧盟官员就新版Siri AI在欧落地进行会谈，因《数字市场法》互操作争议，苹果拒绝向竞争对手开放数据权限，导致新版Siri暂不在欧盟iPhone和iPad上推出。苹果提出的“可信系统代理”方案要求18个月监管宽限期，但遭欧盟拒绝，目前该方案尚未开发。
items.summary_en: Apple CEO Tim Cook held constructive talks with EU officials regarding the delayed launch of a new Siri AI in Europe due to conflicts over data access under the Digital Markets Act. Apple proposed a "trusted system agent" solution requiring an 18-month regulatory grace period, which the EU rejected, leading to the temporary suspension of the feature on iPhones and iPads in the region.

items.title: Apple Creator Studio 更新：更智能、更快速、更互联
items.summary: Apple Creator Studio 推出基于端侧 AI 的更新，Final Cut Pro 新增 Generate Captions 和 Edit Detection 功能，Mac 版强化 Auto Mask 与 Match Color 能力，并支持与 Pixelmator Pro 深度互联。Logic Pro 同步升级 Chord ID 及引入 Grammy 制作人项目模板。该套件订阅价为每月 12.99 美元或每年 129 美元，新用户可享一个月免费试用，教育用户优惠至每月 2.99 美元。
items.summary_en: Apple Creator Studio introduces on-device AI features across its suite, including Final Cut Pro’s auto-captioning and edit detection, Mac’s Auto Mask, and Logic Pro’s enhanced chord identification. The updated ecosystem enables seamless interoperability, allowing users to send frames to Pixelmator Pro and access it directly within Keynote, Pages, and Numbers. Subscription pricing is set at $12.99/month or $129/year, with a free month for new users and a discounted $2.99/month rate for education customers.

items.title: Forward Deployed Engineers and the future of software engineering
items.summary: Sierra的Agent Engineering负责人Natalie Meurer指出，前向部署工程师的核心在于对客户结果的问责制，而非固定的技能组合。Sierra团队由120多名工程师组成，专注于开发结合系统整合与低延迟语音、聊天及邮件交互能力的对话式AI代理，以解决金融等服务行业的高复杂度客户问题。该角色强调将技术能力与客户运营体验深度融合，体现了产品工程与客户导向工程的收敛趋势。
items.summary_en: Sierra employs over 120 "agent engineers" who combine systems integration with deep operational knowledge to build low-latency conversational AI agents for enterprise customer service. This forward-deployed engineering model focuses on accountability to customers, addressing complex, high-emotion scenarios like financial dispute processing through tailored discovery and technical implementation.

items.title: The DeepMind trio who built a poker AI are now making money for quant hedge funds
items.summary: 由三位前DeepMind研究人员创立的布拉格AI实验室EquiLibre Technologies，其估值已超过5亿美元。
items.summary_en: EquiLibre Technologies, a Prague-based AI lab founded by three ex-DeepMind researchers, has achieved a valuation exceeding $500 million. The company applies its expertise in game theory, originally developed for poker AI, to generate profits for quantitative hedge funds.

items.title: Amazon launches new $1 billion FDE org, following OpenAI and Anthropic
items.summary: 亚马逊宣布成立新的10亿美元FDE（前端部署工程师）部门，旨在效仿OpenAI和Anthropic的战略举措。该团队将派遣工程师深入企业客户内部，专注于部署定制化智能体（Agents），以实现快速落地并提升客户的自主使用能力。
items.summary_en: Amazon has launched a new $1 billion First Developer Experience (FDE) organization, mirroring initiatives by OpenAI and Anthropic. The team focuses on embedding engineers within client companies to deploy purpose-built agents, prioritizing rapid deployment and customer self-sufficiency.

items.title: CoreBunch/Instatic
items.summary: Instatic 是由 CoreBunch 开发的现代自托管可视化 CMS，仅需 1 分钟即可通过 Bun 服务器结合 SQLite 或 Postgres 部署。其核心优势在于内置 Core Framework 设计令牌引擎，能自动生成语义化 HTML 和紧凑 CSS，无需框架运行时。支持 Railway 等平台的单键一键部署及 Docker 独立容器运行，实现了从设计到发布的全流程统一。
items.summary_en: Instatic is a self-hosted visual CMS built on a single Bun server that combines the editor, content engine, and publisher to generate clean, semantic HTML without framework bloat. It supports one-click deployment via Railway with SQLite or Postgres databases and features a Core Framework for automated design tokens and responsive layouts.

items.title: 告别硬件出海上一个十年，前安克CMO做了款AI时代的Memory产品｜硬氪专访
items.summary: 前安克CMO王时远创立穗升科技，推出仅11克、待机超30天的AI Memory硬件Memoket，旨在将物理世界信息结构化并交由Agent处理。该产品通过软硬一体模式，超越传统录音笔功能，构建以AI能力为核心的数据入口与护城河。团队遵循“AI First”原则，利用AI工具大幅缩减人力，实现从研发到营销的高效闭环运营。
items.summary_en: Former Anker CMO Wang Shiyuan founded Suisheng Technology to launch Memoket, an 11-gram AI Memory wearable device available as a watch strap or bracelet with over 30 days of standby life. The product structures unstructured physical world information for retrieval by AI Agents, distinguishing itself from traditional recorders by focusing on context management rather than simple transcription.

items.title: Claude Desktop 推出 Linux 公测版
items.summary: Claude Desktop 正式在 Ubuntu 和 Debian 等 Linux 系统上推出公测版。用户可在所有付费方案中享受包括 Claude Code、Claude Cowork 及聊天功能在内的一流桌面体验。
items.summary_en: Claude Desktop has launched its beta version for Linux, supporting Ubuntu and Debian. Users can now access premium features such as Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and chat capabilities across all paid subscription plans.

items.title: Grant Sanderson 谈 AI 与数学的未来
items.summary: Grant Sanderson指出AI获得IMO金牌仅是攻克基准，并不等同于AGI，且即便解决千禧年大奖难题，仍存在大量人类任务难以自动化。对话深入探讨了概念突破验证周期可能长达一个世纪，以及AI证明的可解释性、文献关联发现及强化学习在现实经济任务中的局限性。
items.summary_en: Grant Sanderson argues that AI achieving gold at the International Mathematical Olympiad does not constitute Artificial General Intelligence, but merely represents another benchmark being conquered. He further suggests that while AI might solve Millennium Prize Problems, significant human tasks remain resistant to automation due to long concept verification cycles and the difficulty of applying reinforcement learning to real-world economic scenarios.
